provenance: Frozen synthetic ASR-text regressions plus the exact persisted Whisper transcript reported on 2026-09-28.

cases.rationale: Whisper preserves the identifier characters but not capitalization; an explicit Asset ID must fill the matching schema field.

cases.input: asset identifier is a b c d one two three four
cases.rationale: ASR commonly separates spelled characters and emits digit words.
A colon is a normal field cue and identifier punctuation must be retained.

cases.input: asset id is abcd1234 and inspection result is normal
cases.rationale: The identifier must stop at the next schema cue instead of swallowing the rest of the utterance.
Field-owned dictation already supplies the schema cue through capture context.

cases.input: the asset id might be abcd1234
cases.rationale: An uncertain identifier must not silently become authoritative.

cases.input: asset id is abcd1234, no sorry, abcd1235
cases.rationale: A correction containing two identifiers requires explicit resolution rather than an arbitrary choice.

cases.input: the asset id is not abcd1234
cases.rationale: A negated identifier is not a value assertion.
